title: ask CDP/UIA focus-steal sentinel: CDP transient guard + verification (howto)
desc: T2 howto for ask-cdp-uia-focus-steal-coverage-via-sentinel. CDP transient guard detail and the dated verification test run for the ask gpt/claude/gemini/triad focus-steal sentinel coverage.
steps: CDP TRANSIENT GUARD: applied 2026-04-30 (commit 47c43baf) -- suppresses focus-steal BUG-AUTOs that are caused by normal UIA/CDP interaction (attach/detach transients), not a real involuntary steal

READINESS FAILURE PATTERN: when ask logs show Chrome minimized before tab action, InputReadiness.Probe() blocked on input-cdp, and No response detected -- treat as a UI/input readiness failure rather than a model failure; retry with a fresh tab/session or a different delegation path after restoring focus

SESSION REUSE POLICY: prefer reusing the existing ask session by default; reserve --new-session for stale, contaminated, or broken sessions because unnecessary fresh sessions create noise and fragment continuity.
